strengths: SPY V from original SPY volume
Composite Strength from SPY+QQQ taker NetFlow

protocol.pivotSelection: Fixed hierarchy: same structure + divergence, same structure, active divergence only, original STUMPY; >=12 selected matches per informative group, max20; unresolved structure skips structural levels; no-signal skips divergence-only level; no test-outcome tuning
protocol.pivotEvaluation: Same timestamps/labels/candidate history as original, keep fallback days; paired 5-day bootstrap, report coverage. Divergence-only fallback added after inspecting sparse PRE coverage in the first pivot trial; not selected by predictive gain. Added after viewing V2 history: exploratory, requires future validation.
protocol.pivotSources: SPY high/low; independent original-volume SPY V and Composite Strength; confirmed at right=2 bar CLOSE; daily PRE-to-POST pivots reset, original causal ATR warm-up retained; divergence expires after 8 closed bars
protocol.inputScope: contiguous M15 windows within NY PRE 04:00 through POST 20:00; early close days end POST 17:00
protocol.target: RTH geometry only; PRE=current RTH opening, RTH=unobserved remaining bars, POST=next trading-day RTH opening
protocol.clockMatch: same New York minute, phase and effective target length
protocol.outOfSample: last 40% of target days, one forecast per RTH day; candidates fully complete before input start
protocol.featureHistory: Strength and WLR retain original causal chart warm-up, which may include NIGHT bars; sample windows exclude NIGHT
protocol.limitations: Rule-defined geometry families and conditional analog frequencies are exploratory; not calibrated trading win probabilities. V1 aeon/ensemble has a different 3-bar target and is not combined with these six RTH labels.
